messages:
nora: Quick thought: propose an inline 'fallback snapshot' pill on rollout rows that shows mode, trigger shorthand, sample, cost-delta, and a copyable audit id.

sam: Sounds useful. Keep it single-line so lists don't blow up. What fields exactly?

nora: Minimal: mode|trigger|sample|cost|audit_id. Tap opens small popover with: causal trace (metric -> route -> rule), last matching metric point, and 3 actions: preview, open runbook, escalate.

irene: +1. Must be clear whether pill is a snapshot or live. Snapshots are authoritative for audits. Add microcopy: "snapshot @ 2026-03-22T11:03Z". Also copy button for audit id.

dev-bot: policy-eval: created snapshot snap-20260322-1103 for rollout rfl-881 policy=auto-fallback v4.1 trigger=error_5xx_spike sample=3% fallback=small-lm-a cost_delta=$0.45/1k

max: Action gating: preview -> role=can_preview, escalate/rollback -> role=operator. Every action must return an action_id and append to the snapshot audit_actions list.

nora: API sketch: GET /rollouts/{id}/snapshots/{snap_id} -> flattened fields; POST /rollouts/{id}/actions {action, comment} -> returns action_id. We'll store evaluation_ts and policy_version in snapshot.

sam: Storage note: cap snapshots per-rollout to 100 latest; retention 90d. Perf calc: 1KB/snapshot * 50k/day = ~50MB/day. Fine, index by audit id.

irene: Compliance: input pointers only (sha256 or secured S3 ref), not raw text. Also add cost/quota impact field to help CS determine billing shift.

nora: UX mock (text):
Rollout feature/fast-path   snapshot @2026-03-22T11:03Z
[SNAPSHOT] quiet-degrade | 5xx_spike(>10%) | 3% | +$0.45/1k | audit:snap-20260322-1103  

max: Popover should include a tiny historical metric sparkline and an avg-fallback-duration for similar triggers (last 90d) so oncall knows whether to wait.

dev-bot: telemetry: fallback_triggered audit=snap-20260322-1103 pct=3 trigger=5xx_spike value=12.1%

sam: Next steps: nora will add console mock and example audit blob (flattened strings), max will draft RBAC matrix, irene will confirm compliance pointers. Sync Fri 2026-03-26 14:00 UTC.

nora: will do. thanks! :thumbsup:
